breakdown.description: Counter-flow flame requires opposing inlet velocities; both inlets set to +x
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that a 'counter-flow' configuration requires opposing velocities. The original prompt incorrectly set both the fuel and air inlet velocities to +0.1 m/s. The agent corrected the air inlet velocity to -0.1 m/s, creating the necessary opposing flow, which aligns perfectly with the ground truth's correction.
